authorization: User launch of GOAL.md authorizes generated fixture controls only; no product/private reads.
objective: Verify mechanical sensitivity, deterministic replay and inert admission; no useful-fact or production optimization claim.
identityRule: Distinct logical keys and claim IDs across organization and split; no repeated query counts as an independent sample.
labels: No independent usefulness or must-retain labels. Error estimates unavailable; admissible risk interval [0,1] is ignorance, not a confidence interval.

candidates.method: central plus one-factor +/-10 percent for each of five fields, enumerated in listed field order; no selection, adaptive tuning or holdout feedback
candidates.rationale: Artificial units chosen to exercise inclusive integer cutoffs and fractional decay/pressure. No production rationale or recommendation.

metrics: tier counts and canonical payload bytes
unique edge identities versus selected query rows

tolerance.floatingPoint: same-runtime exact replay; semantic formula checks absolute error <= 1e-12

acceptance.mechanical: Every input accounted, all candidates decoded and hashed, baseline inert, four nonempty strata, cutoffs/scale/budget exercised, repeatable bytes, no authority mutation; independent review and database delete/rebuild proof required.
acceptance.production: Insufficient evidence by design: zero product observations and zero independent labels. No candidate may be selected for production.
acceptance.protocolChange: New immutable version and new held-out identities required after any evaluation-informed change.
